messages:
Maya: Ok team — kickoff for the Lumenary POC perf benchmark. Goal: validate ~2000 qps sustained for their primary text-gen route, with 99th pct latency < 180ms for typical short/medium prompts. They care about burst behaviour and HSM/KMS integration. Ops + perf own the runbook. Tentative window: Wed 11:00 PT.

Ryan: I can own the load harness. Need the exact payload distribution and auth method. Also confirm whether we should test both hosted and dedicated variants.

Maya: @ryan sample corpus attached in the sales email (anonymized): 10k prompts, avg tokens ~48, 95th tokens ~220. Use mix: 70% short (<=64 tokens), 25% medium (65-256), 5% long (>256). Auth: service account with API key for the hosted run; Lumenary asked about KMS/HSM for keys in Dedicated/Private. We'll need answers for the security questionnaire by Tue EOD.

Anu: For the perf plan I suggest three runs:
- Steady-state ramp to 2k qps over 15m (validate throughput & steady tail)
- Microburst: 5m at 6k qps to observe queue/backpressure behavior
- Coldstart churn: create 10k new sessions over 10m to see KV-cache priming effects
I prefer vegeta for qps targeting; can also run a Locust profile for session semantics if we need connection churn.

Ryan: I'll prepare vegeta targets. Quick example to sanity-check (we'll put full request body in the repo runbook):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" > targets.txt
# vegeta attack expects the body in the target or from a file; this is illustrative
vegeta attack -rate=2000 -duration=15m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report
```
Note: we'll instrument the requests with X-Trace-ID and include the token/cost headers so console/cost telemetry lines up with load windows.

Sasha: We currently have 4x A10G reserved in the staging pool on Wed 10:00-14:00 PT. I can request bump to 6 for the window but that needs quick approval from capacity. If we need Dedicated fallback, we can spin a temp pool but private KMS/HSM integration requires network peering and is ~48h lead time. Hosted KMS envelope flow is fine for the hosted run.

Maya: Lumenary asked about burst pricing and commit exposure. Short answer to share: reserved (Dedicated) covers base throughput; additional burst beyond reserved will be billed at on-demand rates and we can model cost using their expected burst minutes. Rough calc for discussion: 2000 qps sustained for 1h ~= X tokens (we'll produce token estimate in the runbook) => estimated $Y for hosted; Dedicated monthly commit options reduce unit cost. I'll post a detailed spreadsheet after the runbook is finalized.

Anu: Acceptance criteria proposal: p99 <= 220ms for short+medium payloads during steady-state, error rate < 0.5%, and no more than 5% requests >500ms during microburst. We'll collect p50/p90/p99 and token-level cost. Also capture per-route breakdown and kernel-level GPU occupancy metrics for follow-ups.

perf-bot: Reminder scheduled: Lumenary benchmark run Wed 11:00 PT. I'll post the run link and aggregated reports to this thread when complete.

Ryan: I'll push the runbook + vegeta scripts to the perf repo and drop the link here once ready. I'll also include the exact command for reproducing the microburst and the JSON payload shape.

Maya: Security questionnaire — primary asks expected: SAML/SCIM SSO details, audit log retention windows, key rotation policies, encryption-at-rest, SOC/ISO attestation location, and KMS/HSM proof points. @sasha can you draft short answers (2-3 bullets each)? We need to return by Tue EOD.

Sasha: On it — will draft answers and post as a doc in ~2h. Also flagging: if they insist on an HSM-backed key in Private, we need 48h minimum for peering and cert provisioning.

Maya: Great. If no blockers, react with :thumbsup:. If you see ops or capacity blockers, call them out now so we can get approvals.

Ryan: :thumbsup: I have the harness and will validate the payload distribution today.

Anu: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the metrics dashboard panels to capture p50/p90/p99 + GPU utilization + token cost.

Sasha: :thumbsup: I'll post the security draft shortly.

Maya: Thanks team — tagging this thread as the canonical run updates. We'll post pre-run checklist 24h before and the final runbook link here.
